topic: Building lasting love during the Fire Horse year. An encouragement to actively tend relationships before the Sheep year arrives, with a weekend challenge to name what you are building.
phrases: The fire was the making of it.
You still have time. Use it.
What you build now, you'll be living in.

images.concept: A woman working quietly in a garden at golden hour. Hands in soil, light warm and unhurried. The image of someone building something with patience and intention, not urgency. This carries the central message of the post: tending the garden is an ongoing, deliberate act.
images.prompt: A woman seen from the side and slightly behind, kneeling in a garden at late afternoon, golden hour light from the right. Her hands are pressed gently into dark soil around the base of a blooming plant. A small act of care, not dramatic labor. She wears a simple linen shirt. The garden around her has other plants in various stages of growth. The light is warm, the air still. The feeling is one of quiet, sustained devotion: someone building something they believe in. Soft sage, antique gold, warm ivory tones. Cinematic film still quality. No text. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: Two women sharing a quiet moment at a table. Hands around cups of tea, mid-conversation, the body language of people who have known each other long enough to be honest. This is what a relationship that has been tended looks like: comfortable, present, real.
images.prompt: Two women in their mid-thirties at a wooden table, both seen from slightly behind and to the side, neither facing the camera. They are mid-conversation, one speaking, the other listening with full attention. Both have cups of tea in front of them. The table has a small vase of fresh flowers. Morning light from a window behind them creates a warm, intimate atmosphere. The feeling is honest, unhurried connection: two people who don't need to perform for each other. Antique gold morning light, warm ivory, soft sage. Cinematic film still quality. No text. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: A woman from behind, sitting at the edge of a sunlit garden in early morning with a cup of tea. Quiet, intentional, unhurried. A moment of pause before the day begins, carrying the question 'what am I building?' without needing to state it.
images.prompt: Square composition. A woman from directly behind, seated on a low garden wall or bench at the edge of a blooming garden, early morning. She holds a cup of tea with both hands. Her posture is relaxed but attentive. She is looking at the garden ahead of her, not at anything beyond it. The garden is softly in bloom: soft sage greens, dusty rose blossoms, antique gold light catching the dew. The morning sky is pale ivory. No other people. The feeling is intimate, reflective, and quietly hopeful. Cinematic film still quality. No text. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.

images.concept: English affirmation card. The most quotable, emotionally decisive line from this week's Feel Good Friday post.
images.prompt: A square affirmation card, 1080x1080. Warm cream paper background with a soft aged texture. Subtle deckle edges on the top and right, a single faint tea-stain ring in the lower right corner, one folded corner top-left catching gentle shadow. The paper fills the frame edge-to-edge. Overhead natural morning light from the upper left. Rendered in the exact center of the paper, in hand-inked brush lettering, deep walnut ink, the phrase: "Tend the garden.". Two lines, centered, the first line slightly larger than the second. The lettering is confident and elegant. Modern calligraphy, not cursive. Spell every word perfectly and space the letters clearly. Preserve any Vietnamese diacritics exactly. One tiny hand-drawn ink flourish beneath the second line. Palette: warm cream, walnut brown ink, a single faint blush tea-stain. The overall feeling is intimate, like a page torn from a woman's journal. No watermarks or Western zodiac imagery anywhere in the image.
